status: prespecified_before_full_10Mb_inference; development method still being selected
not_blinded_development: Public testing-answer exposure disclosed; no values retained or used. Inspected 1Mb cohorts are development only.
development: Existing 1Mb cohorts: GL1 versus GL2, continuation, derivative-free optimizer check.
Prepared 10Mb cohorts with offset10000 are full-width development execution checks, not unseen-demography confirmation.
selection_rule: Choose a likelihood model based on the declared read-error mechanism plus development diagnostics, then freeze all numerical/source settings before fresh confirmation. Any later change invalidates confirmation status.

numerical_gates.contract: All20 diploids, exact population roster, coherent FASTA/BAM dictionary of10Mb, sorted indexed BAMs; exact hashes.
numerical_gates.exposure: Measured retained SAF/realSFS sites over full10Mb; synthetic callable_fraction>=0.99. No complete-case requirement, no full-length substitution.
numerical_gates.sfs_convergence: Original tolerance1e-8 with observed absolute-likelihood-change or probability-update norm stop; followed by separate continuation with same tolerance.
numerical_gates.sfs_stability: After continuation, total L1 frequency change<1e-5, segregating-bin relative L1 change<0.01, each requested target relative change<0.01.
numerical_gates.optimizer: At least8 starts each for L-BFGS-B(log-coordinate eps1e-4) and Powell; both yield interior successful solutions within0.01 log units in parameters and0.01 log-likelihood. Any better boundary or non-converged solution invalidates agreement.

scientific_gates.independent_truth: No challenge truth or final/testing data. Seeds and demographic regimes fixed below. Truth scored only after frozen inference.
scientific_gates.recovery: Each target absolute relative error <=0.30 in every confirmatory cohort, and median absolute relative error <=0.20 over each task. These conservative development gates are not the official metric.
scientific_gates.replication: Three independently prespecified regimes per task, two independent genealogies/read seeds each, 10Mb andBWA-MEM mapping throughout.
scientific_gates.noise: Replicate1 uses individual depth CV from lognormal sigma0.25 and matchedQ30/iid0.001 errors. Replicate2 uses sigma0.5 and matchedQ20/iid0.01 errors. Both retain challenge mean depth2x/4x.
scientific_gates.limits: These tests cannot establish identifiability over all unknown demographies or calibration. Wider bounds/recent events/repeats/indels need explicit follow-up and no readiness claim beyond tested domain.

compute_budget: Gate further work on development diagnostics first. Maximum2 concurrent Slurm jobs,4CPUs and5632M/CPU each. Each initial inference<=2h; continuation<=2h. Twelve confirmation cohorts would cost at most192 CPU-hours for inference/continuation plus<=36 CPU-hours preparation, and are not yet launched. Stop escalation if systematic failure persists.
release_rule: No scientific readiness unless all numerical and scientific gates pass under one frozen policy. Timeouts, changed tolerance, or a single successful cohort do not pass.
